status: direct x-y-time temporal-schedule identity test frozen before schedule-prediction output
role: post-hoc direct mechanism test generated after the 2023 500-m vertical phase-conditioning result; no vertical height enters this test
hypothesis_origin: 500-m place×speed×turn vertical identity passes, but adding early/middle/late phase causes calibrated vertical identity to fail.
ecological_hypothesis: Individuals repeat when during a tracked session they use otherwise similar fine horizontal and kinematic contexts, creating individual-specific temporal schedules that can mediate vertical individuality.

data.phase: relative elapsed-time fraction among valid kinematic endpoints within each session, split into early/middle/late thirds

estimator.self_predictor: equal-session profile from same individual's other sessions
estimator.other_predictor: equal-individual profile from other individuals in same frozen cohort
estimator.target_scoring: target endpoints whose 500-m cell×state context is supported by both self and other predictors
estimator.aggregation: equal target session within individual, then equal individual

structural_expectation.source: matched 500-m place×speed2_turn2 preflight run 36517151763; this n was known before the direct schedule test

calibration.preserve: all x-y-time-derived context and phase values within session plus exact individual session-count multiset
calibration.pass_rule: exact n=11; calibrated observed-minus-null-mean schedule identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05

interpretation.pass: Direct evidence that P. hastatus 2023 individuals have repeatable temporal schedules of fine-place/kinematic context use, supporting temporal allocation as a mediator of the vertical pattern.
interpretation.fail: The vertical attenuation after phase conditioning is not accompanied by detectable repeatable temporal-schedule identity under this direct proxy; support/power or a different phase mechanism remains possible.

claim_boundary: Relative tracked-session phase is not solar/circadian phase.
A PASS does not establish an intrinsic chronotype or wet-season causation.
This is post-hoc mechanism evidence and remains outside v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change 500-m context, speed2_turn2 state, phase3 definition, expected n=11, smoothing, 50-event support, B/seed or pass rule after output.
Do not try phase2 or another grid as rescue.
